Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BROAD –BASED QUALITATIVE REQUIREMENTS 64 SLICE CT SCANNER 1. General (a) The system quoted should be the latest, state of art, multi dete ctor helical CT scanner. (b) The scanner should be capable of comprehensive whole body i magine including cardiac (Calcium Score), abdomen, neuro and va scular imaging application with true isotropic volume acquisition. (c) It should be Make in India Class I or Class II qualification. (d) The CDSCO & AERB compliance for the equipment and its installation would be the responsibility of the suppler. 2. Gantry (a) The CT Scanner should have low Voltage Slip Rings in corporate in the Gantry. (b) The Minimum scan time for a 360 Degree rotation should be les s than or equal to 0.8 second or better. (c) The gantry should be provided with back-lit user control panels or Mobile tablet with wired/ wired remotes for faster patient positio ning. (d) The Gantry should have 3D Positioning Laser lights. (e) The system should be capable of reconstructing/ generating 64 acquisition Slices per rotation for general, and vascular application. (f) The Scan field of view (FOV) in acquisition mode should be 50 c m more for scanning different anatomies. (g) Gantry Aperture should be at least 70 cm diameter. (h) Physical Gantry tilt should be at least +/-20 degree. 3. X ray Generator and Tube

(a) The X ray Generator should be compact and inbuilt in the Gantr y. (b) The System X ray power should be 32 KW (actual power) or mo re. (c) The mA range available should be between 20 mA or less to 40 0 mA steps of not more than 10 mA. (d) Please mention the focal spot size according to IEC (e) The heat storage capacity should be 3.5 MHU actual not effecti ve. (f) The X ray should have a cooling rate of not less than 900 KHU p er min. 4. Detectors (a) The Detector offered should be Solid State (b) The Systems should have at least 32 Physical Rows of detector or more with capability of 64 slices or more per rotation. (c) Each row of detectors should have at least 700 elements. (d) Specif the detector and Z axis coverage for sub mm slice acquis ition. (e) The detectors should not require frequent calibration. 5. Patient Couch (a) The patient table offered should have a minimum load bearing capacity of at least 200 KG. (b) The Minimum table-top height should not be more than 65 cm fr om the floor level for ease of patient loading. (c) The table –top width should be at least 40 cm for better comfort . (d) The range of metal free scan should be at least 160 cm. (e) The vertical range should be at least 35 cm (max height minus min height). (f) Remote UP/DOWN, FWD/BWD of the Patient Couch should be sta ndard. 6. Topogram

(a) The scannogram should be displayed real time. (b) Views should be feasible in frontal and lateral orientations. (c) Should be possible to interrupt acquisition manually if necessar y. 7. Axial/Helical Scanning (a) The system offered should have Spiral Capability of at least 80 seconds or more (b) The range of Spiral scanning in Axial Direction should be more t han 100 cm. (c) Pitch should be freely selectable in auto and manual mode with a range of at least 0.15-1.5. (d) The system should have the Smart Prep or equivalent facility & ability to track Contrast medium to trigger scan 8. Computer (a) The Computer offered should be the Latest Multi-Tasking Proces sors and a menu driven platform with at least 32GB RAM (b) A large Medical grade high resolution LCD color monitor of at le ast 24 inches size. (c) The reconstruction matrix should be at least 512 x 512. (d) The display matrix should be at least 1024 x 1024. (e) The reconstruction time for an Axial scan should not be less tha n 25 images per scan. (f) The Hard disk Capacity for both Image and Raw data should be more than 700 GB. (g) It should have facility to store at least 800,000 Images. (h) The system should be supported with archiving facility of DVD & CD. (j) DICOM facility to send, store, print, receive, Query / Retrieve, M WM, MPPS etc should be standard. (k) PC Based connectivity should be standard for easy transfer of I mages & Report. The image transfer from main console to workstat ion should be automatic and immediate. 9. Independent OEM Workstation: Application to be available on Cons ole or workstation

a There should be a dual 24 inches monitor console and an matche d independent OEM workstation with similar interface as of main co nsole comprising of a single 24” medical grade monitor (at least 2 MP resolution and a display matrix of 1024x1024 or more). b It should have a GUI. c Filming d Archiving on CD /DVD e MPR : Automatic display of MPR Images after scan should be offe red both on console and workstation. f. Brain Perfusion CT Study with automatic CBF, CBV, MTT, TTP map s, ROI placing, comparing ROI, saving maps on console or workstati on. g. Minimum and maximum intensity projection offered both on con sole and workstation. h. 3D volume rendering offered both on console and workstation.. j. Advanced vessel analysis offered both on console and workstatio n.. k. Auto bone removal offered both on console and workstation.. l. Lung nodule assessment offered both on console and workstation .. m. Virtual endoscopy/ colonoscopy offered both on console and wo rkstation.. n. Time point comparison. o. Lung segmentation software for nodule d etection on console. 10. Resolution

(a) High Resolution scan package should be offered as standard wit h minimum slice thickness of 0.625 mm or less. (b) The high contrast resolution should be more than 15 Ip/cm in all routing scans, including spiral and axial mode. (c) Shoulder, Pelvis Streak Artefact suppression Software should be standard. (d) Noise suppression protocols to maintain LCR at low dose should be standard. (e) Special software (like mA modulation in routine to ensure dose efficiency should be standard. (f) Specify the CT Dose Index. (g) Raw dat-based Iterative Reconstruction Technology for Dose-re duction should be standard. (h) Low dose Paediatric CT mode should be available. Pediatric and infant base protocols shall be available based on the infant weight / BMI/age. (i) Patient radiation dose should be displayed on the monitor. 11. Accessories

(a) Make and Model of all the quoted accessories should be specifie d. (b) Dry chemistry camera of DPI 500 or more of any reputed make (c) Lead Glass of 200 x 100 cm.
